hypothesis: Deep CPU idle states (C2 127 us, C3 1048 us exit latency) on the audio cores add wake-up latency that makes audio blocks late; holding PM QoS /dev/cpu_dma_latency at 10 us (C1 only) lowers Live's DSP load, its peaks and PipeWire errors.

change.switch: /dev/cpu_dma_latency = 10 us held for the run (PM QoS)

rationale: No Set improved beyond the A/A spread on DSP average or typical peak (Inbuilts -0.3/+0.5, Max4Live -0.1/+0.5, VSTs -0.2/+0.5 pt); PipeWire errors 63 (A) vs 73 (B) and peaks over 100% 18 vs 18 across 15 Set-runs per arm. The cap held: 0 C2/C3 entries during B runs vs about 7 million per A run. Deep idle states are not what causes the dropouts.
